test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: What does the acronym TULIP, which is an internship programme for fresh graduates and engineers of the country under the ‘Smart City’ projects, stand for?

options.text: Town and Urban Landscape Internship Programme

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Urban Learning Internship Programme.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian citizens who have completed an **undergraduate programme** are eligible to apply for internships through** TULIP within 18 months **of their **graduation.**
 
• Both** AICTE affiliated and non-AICTE college** graduates may apply, and it is open to the degrees and streams listed by **ULBs and smart cities in their prerequisites.**
 
• In order to combine possibilities in **ULBs and smart cities **with the learning requirements of recent graduates, the **Ministry of Housing** and **Urban Affairs (MoHUA) **established "The Urban Learning Internship Program (TULIP)". 
 
• With their **intricate and extensive operations,** ULBs and Smart Cities offer a promising setting for young minds to learn in the real world. **"ULBs and Smart Cities,** with their complex and large operations provide a promising environment for real world learning for young minds," says a large pool of** technical graduates in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** programme aims** to achieve the dual objectives of giving recent **graduates practical learning experience** and assisting States, ULBs, and **Smart Cities** with the injection of new energy and ideas to address pressing issues.
 
• **TULIP aims to develop students**' functional skills while utilising their enthusiasm and ideas to jointly develop solutions for the** future of our communities**. On the TULIP portal, all 100 Smart **Cities** have registered. 
 
• More than **13,000 internships **have been posted by more than 284 Smart Cities/ULBs as of this writing, and more than 100 interns have successfully **completed their internships. **
